title: Miso-Glazed Black Cod with Romanesco & Shirataki
description: Succulent Wild Alaskan Black Cod broiled with savory red miso glaze, served alongside crisp-tender Romanesco broccoli florets and low-carb konjac shirataki noodles.
steps: Rinse konjac shirataki noodles thoroughly under cold water for 2 minutes, then boil in salted water for 3 minutes and drain.
Steam Romanesco broccoli florets over boiling water for 4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Whisk red miso paste and sesame oil together in a bowl until smooth.
Coat black cod fillets evenly with the miso glaze and broil on high for 8-10 minutes until caramelized and tender.
Plate the cod over warm shirataki noodles and Romanesco florets. Serve immediately.

title: Lupin-Crusted Lemon Herb Chicken Tenderloins
description: Pan-sautéed chicken breast tenderloins encrusted with high-protein lupin flour and organic hemp hearts, finished with fresh lemon juice.
steps: In a shallow dish, combine lupin flour, organic hemp hearts, sea salt, black pepper, and fresh lemon zest.
Dredge chicken tenderloins in the lupin-hemp mixture until evenly coated on all sides.
Heat extra virgin olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Sauté chicken cutlets for 5-6 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked to internal temperature of 165°F.
Drizzle with fresh lemon juice before serving.

title: Overnight Vanilla Chia Pudding with Hemp & Toasted Almonds
description: Creamy low-glycemic chia pudding infused with vanilla, topped with crunchy toasted hemp hearts and sliced almonds.
steps: In a mason jar or bowl, whisk black chia seeds, organic hemp hearts, and unsweetened almond milk until well combined.
Cover and chill in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours (or overnight) to allow chia seeds to expand into a rich pudding consistency.
Toast sliced almonds lightly in a dry skillet over low heat for 2 minutes.
Garnish chia pudding with toasted almonds before enjoying.
